verdict.rationale: Replicate is an AI model hosting and inference platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers running models, fine-tuning on your own data, deployment, scaling and pricing. None of it documents a policy or control that keeps customer inputs or outputs out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
